name: orchestra
description: A conductor agent and musician subagents for Claude Code, with a live ledger of who read and changed what, conflict and stale-read detection, and a coda built from the ledger.

narrateCoda.title: Narrate the coda
narrateCoda.description: When the conductor's turn ends with every part settled, Claude retells the coda as prose in a second file beside it. Each narration is one Claude call billed to your login, and needs `npm install` in the plugin's narrate folder.

voiceCoda.title: Speak the coda
voiceCoda.description: When the coda (or its narration) is ready, ElevenLabs reads it into an MP3 beside it. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the environment Claude Code starts from, and a voice id. Each reading is billed to your ElevenLabs account.

voiceId.title: ElevenLabs voice id
voiceId.description: The voice that reads the coda. List voices verified for a language with: node <plugin>/narrate/voice.mjs --voices <language>

voiceLanguage.title: Voice language
voiceLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the coda is read in (the coda and its narration are written in English: en). The voice must be verified for it.

voiceModel.title: ElevenLabs model
voiceModel.description: Text-to-speech model id; empty means eleven_v4, which speaks the requested language. eleven_multilingual_v2 cannot enforce a language.
